name: Leg Injury
text: Revelation - Put Leg Injury into play in your threat area. Leg Injury can be healed as if it were a single point of damage on you (if it is healed, discard it). Forced - After you take a move, resign, or evade action: You cannot take any of those types of actions for the remainder of the turn.
text_cn: 显现 -将腿伤放置入你的威胁区域。 腿伤可被治愈，如同其为你身上的单独1点伤害(如果它被治愈，则将其丢弃)。 强制 - 在你进行移动、撤退或躲避行动后：在该回合剩余时间内你不能再进行任何这些类型的行动。
